brief:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has directed a joint ministerial team and the head of the International Law Administration to begin preparing a potential legal file against Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan at the International Court of Justice, the Shehab Wire reported, citing Israeli broadcaster i24news. The directive follows what Israel characterizes as Erdoğan's pursuit of Netanyahu.

Details of the allegations or specific charges to be included in the case were not immediately disclosed.
